label: GO step choosing a2 late in the episode (plus episode-start D1)
explanation: Fires almost only at GO when the agent is choosing a2 (99.6% of activation mass on action==2 steps; never on D2, never on a1 choices). On its own (GO & a2) that gives 96% recall but 6% precision. The rate depends heavily on episode time: 75% of mass is in trials 90-99 and 14% in trials 0-9, with almost nothing in trials 20-79, and it tracks low model value and a strongly negative choice logit. A minor second component, about 13% of mass, is the very first D1 of an episode (ep_trial 0, active 33% of the time). Magnitude is largest at late-episode GO steps after an unrewarded trial (prev_reward 0 has 89% of mass). Adding prev_reward==0 raises precision to 0.61 but cuts recall too much. Dev: P 0.32, R 0.85, F1 0.47, mass recall 0.93. Precision is limited because many late-episode a2 GO steps after rewarded trials stay silent. The predicate uses only the agent own upcoming choice and the trial index, with no future random outcomes.
